label: About
title: About The Grip Leaves a Gap
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 7 recent saved-signal files and 6 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @zapfriend: Help requested and @bis__cut: 111k, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Grip Leaves a Gap: Landscape ivory cartoon: two unequal fragment groups across an empty gap. A saddle-crowned green creature grips a pale head above a pink mouth; a long cyan-edged mitten limb points inward. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Green crown and gripping contour connected to pale head and long limb, Pink stepped face exposed behind the green silhouette, and Grainy black bowl with turquoise interior.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
